main.summary: Composite runtime security input for `DataItem` protection, unprotection, signing, and verification.
main.remarks: The context combines the local protection identity, the assertion-signing identity, known peers, optional resolution services, recipient intent, and assertion validity metadata into a single input model.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.param: Local object identity and certificate used by the caller.
Optional distinct assertion-signing identity. When null, the local object is also used as the signing identity.
Known peer objects available directly in the context.
Recipient intent configured for the current protection operation.
Optional identity directory used to locate additional known objects.
Optional earliest validity instant for assertion material.
Optional expiration instant for assertion material.
True when the local object should be included as a recipient during protection.

property.name: LocalObject
property.summary: Local protection and decrypt identity used by the caller.

property.name: SigningObject
property.summary: Assertion-signing identity used to issue `DataFieldAssertion` payloads for protected content.

property.name: KnownObjects
property.summary: Known peer objects attached directly to the context.

property.name: Recipients
property.summary: Recipients configured for the current protection operation.

property.name: Directory
property.summary: Optional identity directory used to locate additional known objects.

property.name: NotBefore
property.summary: Optional earliest validity instant for generated assertions.

property.name: ExpiresAt
property.summary: Optional expiration instant for generated assertions.

property.name: IncludeSelfRecipient
property.summary: True when the local object should be included as a recipient during protection.
